assumptions.choice: Use self.data.close[0] as the current market price.
assumptions.reason: The supplied OHLCV M1 feed provides one price value per bar to strategy logic; intrabar tick prices are unavailable.

assumptions.choice: Submit standard Backtrader market orders when a signal is evaluated.
assumptions.reason: With one OHLCV bar per minute and harness-controlled execution settings, true before-close intrabar execution cannot be reproduced; Backtrader fills market orders at its configured next available execution point.

assumptions.choice: Use 100% of available cash per entry, reserving the configured commission, with fractional-share sizing.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires fixed sizing and gives 100% of available capital as its stated example, but does not provide a share quantity.

assumptions.choice: Treat 10:00 through 16:00 local time as inclusive and evaluate signal-based entries/exits only in that interval.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal inclusive reading of 'from 10:00 to 16:00'; the separate first-five-minutes rule is implemented although it is redundant with the 10:00 start.

assumptions.choice: Keep stop-loss and take-profit orders active after entry, including outside the signal-trading window.
assumptions.reason: They are required risk-management orders and no instruction authorizes cancelling them at the end of the high-liquidity period.
